title_i18n.es: El miembro de la Conferencia Consultiva Política del Pueblo Chino, secretario del Comité del Partido y presidente de Tongfang Co., Ltd., Han Yongjiang: propone incorporar la "IA + tecnología nuclear" en el diseño de alto nivel nacional.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 今年全国两会，全国政协委员，同方股份党委书记、董事长韩泳江围绕强化企业创新主体地位、推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合提出多项建议。他呼吁加大人工智能在安检安保、工业、农业、医疗等领域的赋能应用，建议将“AI+核技术”纳入国家层面顶层设计，配套相应政策与资源支持，加快推动我国核技术应用产业实现跨越式发展。（证券时报）
excerpt_i18n.en: During this year's National Two Sessions, Han Yongjiang, a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and Party Secretary and Chairman of Tongfang Co., Ltd., put forward multiple proposals focusing on strengthening the role of enterprises as the main drivers of innovation and promoting the deep integration of technological innovation with industrial innovation. He called for increased application of artificial intelligence in fields such as security inspection, industry, agriculture, and healthcare. He also suggested incorporating "AI + nuclear technology" into the national-level top-level design, supported by corresponding policies and resources, to accelerate the leapfrog development of China's nuclear technology application industry. (Securities Times)
excerpt_i18n.es: En las Dos Sesiones de este año, Han Yongjiang, miembro del Comité Nacional de la Conferencia Consultiva Política del Pueblo Chino y secretario del comité del partido y presidente de Tongfang Co., presentó varias propuestas centradas en fortalecer el papel de las empresas como protagonistas de la innovación y promover la integración profunda entre la innovación científica-tecnológica y la industrial. Hizo un llamado para potenciar la aplicación de la inteligencia artificial en áreas como la seguridad en inspecciones, la industria, la agricultura y la atención médica, sugiriendo incorporar la "IA + tecnología nuclear" en el diseño de alto nivel a nivel nacional, acompañado de políticas y recursos de apoyo correspondientes, para acelerar el desarrollo exponencial de la industria de aplicaciones de tecnología nuclear en China. (Securities Times)

items.title: Agent-pulse – local gateway that fans out AI agent events to clients
items.raw_excerpt: I wanted Claude Code to notify my ESP32 when it finished a task. A `curl` in the Stop hook worked — until I needed a local dashboard too. The dashboard couldn't expose an HTTP endpoint, it needed to subscribe. And every new client meant editing hook configs across all my projects. So I built agent-pulse: a local gateway that captures AI agent lifecycle events and fans them out to registered clients. You register clients once in a global YAML. Projects just call `agent-pulse hook --provider claude --event stop` from their hooks. The gateway handles routing, per-client filtering, and parallel dispatch. It auto-starts on the first event. Two delivery modes: HTTP POST fan-out for webhooks and scripts, SSE stream (`GET /events/stream`) for dashboards and anything that can't expose an endpoint.

On March 5, 2026, the Yangtze River Delta (Deqing) Embodied Intelligence Data Collection Training Ground and the launch event for the industry's first physical AI data foundation platform, "Boundless," hosted by Unquestionable Intelligence Technology, concluded successfully at the Deqing International Conference Center. Themed "Boundless Expansion, Building the Future," the event brought together top experts and scholars in embodied intelligence, leading industry partners, representatives from renowned investment institutions, and government officials from provincial, municipal, district, and county levels. Through keynote speeches, product launches, technical sharing, roundtable discussions, and on-site visits, participants explored new pathways for breakthroughs in embodied intelligence data and its practical applications.  

As a globally leading provider of physical AI data foundations, Unquestionable Intelligence Technology showcased multiple core segments at the event, including guest speeches, core product launches, in-depth technical sharing, high-end roundtable forums, and on-site visits to the training ground. The event comprehensively demonstrated the company's robust technical capabilities in embodied intelligence data, forward-looking industry layout, and firm commitment to building an industrial ecosystem. It also allowed guests from various sectors to immerse themselves in the new possibilities of embodied intelligence industry development.  

At the beginning of the event, relevant leaders from Deqing County delivered speeches, extending warm congratulations on the launch of the Boundless data foundation platform and expressing high recognition for the concept of the Yangtze River Delta (Deqing) Embodied Intelligence Data Collection Training Ground as an open, shared, and mutually beneficial industrial data infrastructure.  

Dr. Yu Kai, founder of Horizon Robotics and chief advisor of Unquestionable Intelligence Technology, delivered a keynote speech titled "High-Quality Data Drives Embodied Intelligence."
excerpt_i18n.es: El 5 de marzo de 2026, el evento de lanzamiento del campo de entrenamiento para la recopilación de datos de inteligencia corporeizada en el Delta del Yangtsé (Deqing) y la primera plataforma base de datos de IA física del sector, "Sin Límites", organizado por WuWen Intelligence, concluyó con éxito en el Centro Internacional de Conferencias de Deqing. Bajo el lema "Expandir Fronteras Sin Límites, Cimentar el Futuro", la conferencia reunió a destacados expertos académicos, socios industriales líderes, representantes de reconocidas instituciones de inversión y autoridades gubernamentales de diversos niveles provinciales, municipales y locales. A través de discursos temáticos, presentaciones de productos, intercambios tecnológicos, mesas redondas y visitas in situ, se exploraron conjuntamente nuevas vías para superar los desafíos de los datos de inteligencia corporeizada y su aplicación práctica.
